title: 1989 Topps #784 Steve Avery Atlanta Braves Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1989 Topps Steve Avery rookie trading card (#784) featuring the Atlanta Braves MLB player. The card is part of the 1989 Topps set and manufactured by Topps. It is a sports trading card for baseball collectors, specifically fans of the Atlanta Braves. Steve Avery is the highlighted player on this rookie card, which is a sought-after collectible for baseball card enthusiasts.
